text: My first visit was very impressive. The clinic looks like a regular shophouse, but the service is excellent. The location is great, right on the main road and easy to find. The dentist is polite, speaks nicely, and is gentle. She let me rest my mouth and constantly asked if I was tired or experiencing sensitivity. The dentist gave good advice and let me choose the treatment I wanted and a convenient time. Importantly, the dentist and assistant didn't chat amongst themselves, which was very pleasant. I will definitely come back again.
The orthodontist here is beautiful, comprehensive, and offers a complete range of services all in one place. The doctor is board-certified and has been receiving treatment here since I was a child.
The doctor is very kind, gentle, and talks about the treatment process with a kind heart. I used to be afraid of going to the dentist, but now I feel comfortable seeing the doctor.
